title: Field extra toilets
description: field/extra_toilets.yaml of the game pack: more places where the partner can go, used with the extra toilets option (an engine improvement, docs/modulos/apps/game.md). Positions and rotations are on the original's axes and units, like the map table's toilets.

map.description: The map id it is on.

position.description: Where the partner goes (x, z on the original's axes); its cell and the eight around it take the toilet trigger where they are free.

facing.description: The original Y rotation (0-4095) its front faces: the partner stops one cell that way before walking in.
